A-11 Seat reservation (complimentary / partner)

Bangla name: সিট রিজার্ভেশন (কমপ্লিমেন্টারি / পার্টনার)

← 10 · Admin portal · Contents · Open queries

1. Name and purpose

Seat reservation. An admin sets seats of a level aside so that they are not sold online, for complimentary tickets (given free) or partner tickets (given to a partner or sold offline). A reservation reduces the online capacity of the level, has a number, and later produces tickets (A-12); releasing seats returns them to online sale or marks how they were used. Concepts: Redis live capacity, distributed locks, queue-driven processing.

2. Trigger and actor

Staff on the event's Gallery Update tab (/events/event-details/:id, columns "Remaining Reserved" and "Released") and the Generate Tickets menu (/events/event-ticket, /events/generate-ticket/:id). On the server only summary/{eventId} and event/{eventId} require the admin policy; POST /seat-reservation itself has no [Authorize] (X-18).

3. Business flow

  1. Reserve: pick the level, type (Complimentary or Partner), category (DigitalPrint, Printing, ReservedOnly), number of seats (or exact seats for a seated level, or a percentage of the level).
  2. The reservation gets a reservation number and status Draft; it appears in "Remaining Reserved".
  3. Release: from a reservation, release some or all of the seats with a release category: DigitalPrint, Printing, ReservedOnly (the seats were used for tickets) or ToOnline (the seats go back to online sale).
  4. When all seats of a reservation have been released, the parent reservation becomes Closed.

4. Technical flow

  1. [HTTP + user token] List GET /booking/api/v1/seat-reservation/by-event-level?eventId&levelId&actionType&programId; summary for the Generate Tickets page GET /booking/api/v1/seat-reservation/summary/{eventId}?levelId&programId (admin policy); counts GET .../count/{eventId}, GET .../remainingReserveCount/{eventId}, GET .../reservations-count?eventId&levelId.
  2. [HTTP + user token] Save POST /booking/api/v1/seat-reservation with SeatReservation. SeatReservationManager.CreateAsync: - validate: ids greater than 0, NumberOfSeats > 0, a release needs the parent ReservationId, the gallery, block and level must be active (gallery_or_block_or_level_inactive), and for a release the parent must exist ("Selected Reservation is not found."), the released amount must be below the reserved amount ("Released Number of seats must be less than reserved seats."), and the parent must not be Locked ("Can't release right now. Reservation is in ticket process."); - take the lock level_booking_{event}_{gallery}_{block}_{level} (expiry 30 s, wait 15 s) (X-25); - for a release, or a new reservation (no parent), call CapacityManager.BookLevelCapacity(... isIncrease = (action == Released), orderType = Admin, capacityAction = Reservation): Redis live capacity is decremented (reserve) or incremented (release) at once, the live seat list is updated, and OrderSuccess and EventCapacity messages are published (S-01, S-02); - insert the SeatReservation row: PublicId, ReservationNumber (unique code), Status = Draft, Type, ReservationCategory, ReleaseCategory, seats, RemainingReservedSeat, MergeStatus/ZipStatus = None, CreatedBy; - when releasing against a parent reservation number, ReduceRemainingReservedSeatAsync lowers the parent's remaining count; a fully released parent is set to Closed; - delete event_total_online_ticket:{eventId}.
  3. Bulk: POST /booking/api/v1/seat-reservation/event/{eventId}?percentage=65 (admin policy) reserves ceil(percentage % of TotalCapacity) seats on every level of the event, one reservation per level (percentage 0 to 100).
  4. Status updates used by other features: PATCH .../update-reservation-status/{publicId}, update-merge-status, update-zip-status, GET .../merge-status/{publicId}, zip-status/{publicId} (S-09).

9. Handover notes

  1. No authorization on create and read. Reserving or releasing seats needs no token on the server, only the summary and bulk endpoints do.
  2. Reservation reduces online capacity at once, in Redis, and the database follows by queue (S-01); two parallel reservations on one level are serialised by the 15-second lock.
  3. The bulk endpoint has no caller in the portal that this review found, and its default 65 % is an unexplained constant (CreateBulk(long eventId, int percentage = 65)); keep it out of the interface unless the business confirms its use [UNCONFIRMED: Q-22].
  4. ReservationStatusUpdateService is not registered: the Booking worker class that would move Requested reservations to Generated exists but nothing hosts it (Appendix A); statuses move through the explicit PATCH calls.
  5. Release categories decide the accounting: ToOnline increases online capacity again; the other three keep the seats out of online sale and record how they were used. A report that sums reserved and released seats must account for this (A-22).
  6. Locked is set by Ticketing while it creates the reserved tickets of a reservation (TicketManager.cs:1357) and sets Requested after queuing the signing jobs (:1424); during that time a release is refused with "Can't release right now. Reservation is in ticket process." If ticket creation stops half-way, the reservation can stay Locked and cannot be released until its status is reset (A-12).
